nodes.name: CompanyPayrollFilterRequest.java
nodes.summary: Company payroll filter request DTO: departmentId, month, year, status, page, size, sortBy, sortDir. HR/admin view for company payroll runs.

nodes.name: EditPayrollRequest.java
nodes.summary: Edit payroll request DTO: payrollId, baseSalary, allowances, bonuses, deductions, taxAmount, netSalary, note. HR correction for individual payroll records.

nodes.name: StaffPayrollFilterRequest.java
nodes.summary: Staff payroll filter request DTO: month, year, status, page, size. Employee self-view for pay slip history.

nodes.name: CompanyPayrollResponse.java
nodes.summary: Company payroll response DTO: payrollId, userId, employeeCode, fullName, department, jobTitle, month, year, baseSalary, allowances, bonuses, overtimePay, deductions, taxAmount, netSalary, status, generatedAt. HR view.

nodes.name: MonthlyPayrollSummaryResponse.java
nodes.summary: Monthly payroll summary response DTO: month, year, totalEmployees, totalGrossPay, totalNetPay, totalTax, totalOvertimePay, departmentBreakdown (list of dept, count, gross, net). Executive summary.

nodes.name: StaffPayrollResponse.java
nodes.summary: Staff payroll response DTO: payrollId, month, year, baseSalary, allowances, bonuses, overtimePay, deductions, taxAmount, netSalary, status, generatedAt, paySlipUrl. Employee self-view with download link.

nodes.name: MonthlyPayrollSummary.java
nodes.summary: MonthlyPayrollSummary JPA entity: id, month, year, totalEmployees, totalGrossPay, totalNetPay, totalTax, totalOvertimePay, status (DRAFT, FINALIZED, PAID), generatedAt, finalizedAt. Aggregate payroll run record.

nodes.name: Payroll.java
nodes.summary: Payroll JPA entity: id, userId, month, year, baseSalary, allowances, bonuses, overtimePay, deductions, taxAmount, netSalary, status (DRAFT, FINALIZED, PAID), paySlipPath, generatedAt, finalizedAt, paidAt. Individual payroll record linked to attendance/leave/overtime.

nodes.name: PayrollStatus.java
nodes.summary: PayrollStatus enum: DRAFT, FINALIZED, PAID. Workflow states for payroll processing.

nodes.name: PayrollException.java
nodes.summary: Payroll exception: extends RuntimeException with error codes (PAYROLL_LOCKED, INVALID_MONTH_YEAR, PAYROLL_NOT_FOUND, CALCULATION_ERROR, PAYSLIP_GENERATION_FAILED, ALREADY_PAID, INSUFFICIENT_DATA). Caught by GlobalExceptionHandler.

nodes.name: AdminController.java
nodes.summary: Admin REST controller: endpoints for user management (getAllUsers, getUserDetail, createPendingUser, provisionAccount, rejectPendingUser, resetPassword, updateStatus, savePermissions), session management (getUserSessions, revokeSession), and system config. ADMIN role only.

nodes.name: AdminResetPasswordRequest.java
nodes.summary: Admin reset password request DTO: userId, newPassword, confirmPassword. Admin-initiated password reset with validation.

nodes.name: AdminUpdateStatusRequest.java
nodes.summary: Admin update status request DTO: userId, status (ACTIVE, INACTIVE, LOCKED), reason. Account status management by admin.

nodes.name: CreatePendingUserRequest.java
nodes.summary: Create pending user request DTO: email, fullName, departmentId, jobId, managerId. Pre-provisioning for new hires before they sign up.

nodes.name: ProvisionAccountRequest.java
nodes.summary: Provision account request DTO: pendingUserId, username, temporaryPassword, sendEmail. Activates pending user account and sends credentials.

nodes.name: RejectPendingUserRequest.java
nodes.summary: Reject pending user request DTO: pendingUserId, reason. Rejects pre-provisioned user (e.g., offer declined).

nodes.name: SavePermissionsRequest.java
nodes.summary: Save permissions request DTO: userId, permissions (map of PermissionKey to boolean). Granular permission management per user.

nodes.name: AdminAccountResponse.java
nodes.summary: Admin account response DTO: userId, username, email, fullName, status, roles, permissions, department, jobTitle, lastLogin, createdAt. Full admin view.

nodes.name: AdminSessionResponse.java
nodes.summary: Admin session response DTO: sessionId, userId, ipAddress, userAgent, createdAt, lastAccessedAt, isCurrent. Session monitoring for security.

nodes.name: PendingUserResponse.java
nodes.summary: Pending user response DTO: pendingUserId, email, fullName, department, jobTitle, manager, createdAt, expiresAt. Pre-hire tracking.

nodes.name: UserPermissionResponse.java
nodes.summary: User permission response DTO: userId, permissions (PermissionKey -> granted). Current effective permissions for user.

nodes.name: AdminService.java
nodes.summary: Admin service: implements user provisioning, password reset, status updates, permission management, session revocation, and pending user lifecycle. Integrates with UserProfileRepository, UserSessionRepository, PermissionService.
